# Will this franchise unit actually pay you?

> Free franchise calculator: fee, build-out, loan, sales ramp, costs and royalties in; payback, IRR, break-even sales, the cash cushion you need and whether the brand beats going independent out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
